name: Formula Velocity VR
summary:
Formula Velocity VR is the formula car racing experience Meta Quest has been waiting for.
Slide into a fully immersive open-wheel cockpit, grip the virtual steering wheel with your own hands, and push a high-performance formula car to its absolute limit. Every corner, every overtake — felt in full VR.
🏎️ Three Hand-Crafted Circuits
Three tracks built ground-up for VR — tight street sections, sweeping high-speed corners, and technical infields that challenge every skill level.
🎮 True VR — No Compromises
